      "id": "n_calibration_interval",
      "name": "calibration interval",

      "anchor": "a calibration interval",
      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0018"
    },

      "location": "webb-2026-state-fidelity-validity#c0018"
    },
